player_prompt.intro:
Uyiyithonji {player_id}. Uyidlala igemu le-15-Puzzle.
Injongo yeludi eyakhiwe ukulungisa itayili ezinomboro kwiindlela ephakamileyo kuka-1 ukuya kude ku-15, ngamnye indawo esikhulu ikweliwe kwisithili sesikhululo.
Ukwenza imovo, uyakwazi ukususwa itayili kwindawo esikhulu (ekwaziwa ngamagqala amabini, e.g. __) ngokutumia imfuno yimali:
- 'up': Susa itayili ngaphakathi komhlaba indawo esikhulu phezulu.
- 'down': Susa itayili ngaphakathi komhlaba indawo esikhulu phantsi.
- 'left': Susa itayili ngaphakathi komhlaba indawo esikhulu kwisitha.
- 'right': Susa itayili ngaphakathi komhlaba indawo esikhulu kwindawo.
Ukwenza imovo yakho, nxibelela ndlela (e.g., 'up', 'down', 'left', or 'right') kwizigqibo, e.g. [up].
Ubuni bokwenziwa kwebhoji bonyulwa hapa naphantsi. Sebenzisa ulwazi ukulungisa iphazile.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomathi yokudlula engekho mthethweni. Umdlali {player_id} akazange aphendule ngecala elifanelekileyo kwiikhonkco zesikwere.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Intshukumo engekho semthethweni. Itile ayinakushukunyiswa kwicala elichaziweyo.

outcome.win: Sivuyisana nawe! Umdlali {player_id} uphumelele ukusombulula i-Puzzle ye-15.
outcome.turn_limit: Umda wenguqu ufikelelwe. Imodeli igqibe {percent} ekhulwini lephazili
